about: Save The Penguin is a 3D snow adventure in which the main objective is to defeat enemy penguins by throwing snowballs while avoiding the snowballs thrown by them. Each level takes place in a snowy environment with floating platforms, trees, mushrooms, rocks, and orange clouds in the sky, along with floating fish. Collect fish to survive, unlock the pickaxe, and break the chains to rescue a trapped penguin.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
